ops.title: Cleanup quiet roots must use the same canonical paths as jobs
ops.description: Owner: Yasyf Mohamedali. Next step: canonicalize configured quiet directories consistently with worktree identification. Evidence at 60eefaf1b: cleanup_caps.go:44-48 only cleans strings; relocate/preflight.go:67-68 resolves symlinks and stores the resolved Original at line 149; api.go:407-408 compares literal strings. A quiet root naming a symlink does not protect jobs reached through it. Source-only review; no tests ran.

ops.text: A configured symlink to a directory protects jobs in that directory after their paths are resolved.
Unresolvable configured roots produce an explicit configuration error rather than silently weakening protection.
